decisions.reason: Building on established milling and accessory know-how, the firm can assimilate and improve it, so withdrawal risk is low.
As a distant technology, the firm lacks the related knowledge to interpret early results and enhance it, making withdrawal likely.
Close to core high-speed milling equipment, the firm's absorptive capacity supports learning and product refinement, so we keep it.
The tool change system builds on existing precision tools and modular engineering, enabling effective evaluation and improvement.
